title: 单词重复
problem_statement_md:
编写一个程序，将一个给定的单词重复输出**N**次。

输入一个字符串及数字，字符串作为单词，将该单词重复输出指定次数。

示例代码完成了输入部分，并使用输入作为参数调用**repeat**()函数。
你需要自定义**repeat**()函数。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Word Repeater[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You need to make a program which repeats a given word [b]N[/b] number of times.

The program needs to take a string and a number as input and output the string repeated the given number of times on separate lines.

The given code takes the inputs and calls the [b]repeat[/b]() function with those arguments.
You need to create the [b]repeat[/b]() function.

[b]Sample Input:[/b]
hello
4
[b]Sample Output:[/b]
hello
hello
hello
hello

[note]Use a [b]loop[/b] in the function to repeat the output.[/note]
hint_md: 在函数中使用一个**for**循环来重复输出。

code_templates.template:
package main
import "fmt"


func main() {
    var w string
    fmt.Scanln(&w)
    var x int
    fmt.Scanln(&x)

    repeat(w, x)
}
